parameters.name: ForceModel
parameters.description: The model to which requests are forcibly routed.

parameters.name: ModelCategory
parameters.description:
The model API category. Valid values:

- **text**

- **embedding**

- **rerank**

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The model API protocol. Valid values:

- **OpenAI**

- **Anthropic**

- **Model Studio**

- **vLLM**

parameters.name: RecordInput
parameters.description: Specifies whether to record input for billing.

parameters.name: RecordOutput
parameters.description: Specifies whether to record output for billing.

parameters.name: RouteRules
parameters.description: A list of routing rules, provided as a JSON array string.
